newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal takes interest in Davco.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal takes interest in Davco.

text.p: AlliedSignal Inc said Tuesday it has purchased a one-third interest in Davco Manufacturing LLC, a manufacturer of diesel fuel processing devices.
Other partners in Davco include Detroit Diesel Corp and Stephen Davis, president of Davco.

AlliedSignal Filters & Spark Plugs, a unit of AlliedSignal, currently supplies fuel filter cartridges to Davco. AlliedSignal is a key supplier of heavy-duty truck filters and other products to Detroit Diesel.
Davis said Davco's sales are expected to grow about 10 percent annually as it expands into new markets, such as off-highway vehicles and marine applications.
